# R6.38 — E2-T5 + E2-T6(a): strategy params / submit marker / retry policy + `open_session.exec` (manifest 296)

Harness: devin-cli / swe-2-high / subagent — engineered (offline, $0.00)

Three-leg ticket. Stage 1 applies the GATE-G24-approved AR-24 amendment
verbatim to §5e.1 (`stop_rule` gains `submit{marker, line,
require_returncode}`). Stage 2 (E2-T5) decodes the `control_strategy`
slot's `params` into `StrategyParams` at arm and resume, detects the
declared submission marker on the settled raw output in the dispatch
path, and declares the envelope's transport-retry table per definition.
Stage 3 (E2-T6(a)) adds the optional `exec` member to `open_session`
and arms the definition's exec capabilities over the session's
environment handle through the existing `executor::bind` check.

## Stage 1 — AR-24 application (docs-only commit `866fd906`)

- `spec/sections/05e-control-orchestration.md` — the Parameters bullet's
  `stop_rule ∈ {no_action, submit, either}` becomes
  `stop_rule ∈ {no_action, submit{marker, line, require_returncode},
  either}` plus the amendment's marker paragraph (marker literal is
  harness data — a `Text` leaf at `authority = definition`, never a
  kernel constant; `line ∈ {first}` closed sum; `require_returncode`
  the settled `returncode` integer); the `react/minimal` spelling gains
  `submit{marker: <the variant's declared Text leaf>, line: first,
  require_returncode: 0}` with detection semantics unchanged.
- `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` — the same two edits on the inline copies
  (~l.3894/~l.3906) plus the canonical front-matter status-line note
  (approver GATE-G24, "yes, authorized, proceed", applied text sha256
  `3168f50898d6d4448b5dd6f8533de3c81e256fdfe5f84aff513f31061de138bb`).
- `docs/tickets/00_MANIFEST.md` — dated `## Spec amendments applied`
  entry naming the GATE-G24 approver and the draft sha (R4.15a/b/c
  precedent). **Verification:** the draft's *After* text appears
  verbatim (whitespace-normalized paragraph match) in both spec files;
  `git diff --stat` on `spec/` touches only the amendment region +
  the status line. No other `spec/` byte changes.

## Stage 2 — E2-T5 (REQ-XE-115/116/117)

- **`hh-control/strategy.rs`** — `StopRuleParam::Submit{marker:
  Option<SubmitMarker>}` (the bare `submit` stays the dormant
  shorthand; the record form carries `SubmitMarker{marker, line:
  SubmitLine::First, require_returncode}`); `FormatFailureScope{Batch}`
  + `StrategyParams.format_failure_scope` (G9b — the only admitted
  scope; the strict pipeline already fails the response on its first
  malformed call, `call` refuses typed).
- **`hh-control/wire.rs`** — `stop_rule_to_json`/`stop_rule_from_json`
  (string and `{submit:{marker,line,require_returncode}}` forms);
  `params_to_json`/`params_from_json` gain `format_failure_scope`;
  **`strategy_params_overlay`** — the sparse slot-param decode: present
  members decode through the per-member codecs, absent members keep the
  variant preset, unknown members refuse `StrategyParamError::
  UnknownMember`, `completion_surface` is an admitted passthrough the
  R6.36 surface arm owns; `strategy_params_to_json`/`from_json` are the
  persistence spellings (public).
- **`hh-embed/open.rs`** — `arm_driver` overlays
  `control_strategy_params(doc)` over the variant preset
  (`InvalidDefinition` on refusal) and returns `(Driver,
  StrategyParams)`; `LeafArm.strategy_params` persists the resolved
  record on `leaf.arm` (X-04 — durable before the drive uses it);
  `arm_resume_driver` re-reads the persisted record verbatim
  (`strategy_params_from_json`), falling back to the same overlay over
  the persisted sealed definition for pre-R6.38 records; `adopt.rs`
  updated. `apply_transport_retry` decodes `model_port`
  `retry{attempts, classes}` into `EnvelopePolicy.retry` at both arm
  paths — declared classes get `MaxAttempts::Bounded(attempts)` +
  the audited transient backoff (waits are ledgered on
  `control.retry.scheduled`, never compared); undeclared model-call
  classes lose their spec (a declaration is total); the kernel-fixed
  `NEVER_RETRYABLE` set is not resurrectable.
- **`hh-env`** — `DispatchInput.submission_marker` +
  `SubmissionMarker{marker, line: SubmitLine, require_returncode}` +
  `marker_detected` (pure predicate — `line = first` means the output's
  first line equals the literal and the settled `returncode` equals
  `require_returncode`); detection runs in `dispatch_at` on the settled
  masked `raw_output` (the `raw_output_ref` bytes — never the
  model-view rendering, never an executor hint) and mints
  `obs.submission_ref = Some("sub-{effect_id}")` on the `Observation`;
  `Observation.submission_ref` serializes absent-not-null onto the
  `action.effect.observed` terminal (the same audit member the
  non-durable path stamps — the replay fold re-serves it verbatim,
  ADR-0135 §2). Unarmed dispatches mint no member — byte-identical
  (the opt-in rule).
- **`hh-embed/runtime.rs`** — `DispatchGate.submission_marker` armed
  in `service.rs::drive` from `sess.leaf_arm.strategy_params`;
  `dispatch_exec` passes it into `DispatchInput` and forwards the
  settled observation's `submission_ref` on `GateOutcome` (Observed /
  ObservedCached / Duplicate all forward the recorded ref); the cap's
  monitor gains the per-dispatch scope coordinates (`turn_id`,
  `effect_id`, `run_id` when vacated — an arm-set `run_id` is the
  arm's own record).

## Stage 3 — E2-T6(a) / REQ-XE-118 (AR-25 shape)

- **`hh-embed-schema`** — `ExecArmDecl{env: string, surfaces: [string]}`
  strict-decoded (unknown members refuse); `OpenSessionParams.exec:
  Option<ExecArmDecl>`; schema table gains `ExecArmDecl` + the `exec`
  member. Regenerated via `hh-codegen`: `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
  `schema/compat-1.matrix.json` (new schema hash), `generated.rs`,
  `clients/ts/hh-embed.ts` — never hand-edited (CC7).
- **`hh-embed/open.rs`** — `arm_session_exec` runs at open when `exec`
  is declared: `env` must spell `session` (other spellings
  `SchemaViolation`); each `surfaces` semantic id resolves to a
  `ToolCapability` node with a `Tool` surface record and an
  `exec`-domain `EffectClass`; `bind_surface` compiles the binding;
  the executor is `LocalExecutor` for `local_host` envs,
  `take_executor` for helper-backed (`local_sandboxed`/
  `local_container`) envs, a typed `Refused` otherwise; the Π monitor
  carries the capability entry + proposer label + covering table; the
  caps land through `arm_exec_capabilities` — the existing
  `executor::bind` re-check refuses an executor that cannot satisfy
  `execution_requirement` (CC1 — no second binding implementation).
  Absent `exec` ⇒ no arming, byte-identical legacy behavior.
